article: Post to Slack safely with an Incoming Webhook from C++ (WinHTTP)
findings: Clarified that an Incoming Webhook URL is a secret credential, moved it out of source code to the SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL environment variable, and restricts the sample to HTTPS and hooks.slack.com.
Replaced the leaking/incomplete WinHTTP example with RAII handles and checks for every request stage, HTTP 200, and Slack's plain-text `ok` response.

Removed channel, username, and icon overrides from payload examples because Slack Incoming Webhooks do not support overriding those installation settings; pointed readers to chat.postMessage with chat:write for other operations.

Corrected WinHTTP from a C++ standard library to a Windows API, described UTF-8 JSON and serializer needs, preserved the original 2025-07-16 date, and added localized metadata and official references.
Compared the complete Japanese article with all twelve translations, including the shared code and JSON payload, metadata, security notes, and internal/external references.

post/C++（Win32 API + WinHTTP）でSlackにメッセー.source: post/C++（Win32 API + WinHTTP）でSlackにメッセージを投稿する方法【Webhook対応】/index.md

meaning.note: Compared the full translation with Japanese, including Incoming Webhook setup, secret handling, Windows API scope, request lifecycle, JSON payload, response result, limitations, and conclusion.

terminology.note: Checked Incoming Webhooks versus the Web API, webhook URL as a secret credential, HTTPS, WinHTTP/Win32, UTF-8, JSON serialization, `chat:write`, and `chat.postMessage` terminology across editions.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical derivations or numerical calculations.

code.note: Reviewed the shared synchronous C++/WinHTTP example for URL parsing and HTTPS/host restriction, environment-variable secret input, RAII handle cleanup, byte lengths, send/receive errors, HTTP status, and Slack's `ok` body. It was not compiled or run.

links.note: Checked Slack's official Incoming Webhooks behavior and Microsoft Learn references for WinHttpCrackUrl and WinHttpSendRequest; these references appear in all editions.

post/C++（Win32 API + WinHTTP）でSlackにメッセー.summary: Reviewed the complete translation against Japanese, corrected the WinHTTP classification, replaced the incomplete/leaking code with a checked RAII example, protected webhook credentials, and corrected unsupported webhook customization claims.
limitations: AI review only; no human or native-speaker certification.
The WinHTTP C++ sample was not compiled or run; no Slack workspace message was sent.
The example targets standard Slack webhook hostnames and a synchronous desktop application; GovSlack and asynchronous use are not covered.
Hugo CI and live publication verification remain pending for this batch.
